rejectedNotes: Socrates wrote nothing; no videos or posts. Discovery candidates ignored. Late dialogues where Socrates is silent or minor (Laws, Timaeus, Sophist, Statesman, Critias, Parmenides, Philebus) skipped. MIT Internet Classics Archive truncates pages at ~100KB, so Meno, Protagoras, Symposium, Euthydemus, Gorgias, Phaedo, Theaetetus and Republic III and V were written from the same Jowett translation via Project Gutenberg (Jowett introductions removed); Gorgias, Phaedo and Theaetetus are split into two parts, the second part linking to the Gutenberg ebook. Xenophon (Dakyns) comes from Gutenberg with Dakyns' footnotes stripped; Memorabilia books and Oeconomicus halves use distinct Gutenberg URLs of the same ebook. Oeconomicus chapters VII-XXI dropped: mostly Ischomachus speaking, not Socrates.
gaps: No Hippias Major/Minor, Menexenus, Cratylus or Clitophon
